titles.title: Protecting Kids from Fentanyl Act of 2025
Protecting Kids from Fentanyl Act of 2025

To amend the Public Health Service Act to authorize the use of Preventive Health and Health Services Block Grants to purchase life-saving opioid antagonists for schools and to provide related training and education to students and teachers, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.

bill.summary:
Protecting Kids from Fentanyl Act of 2025
This bill permits the use of the Preventive Health and Health Services Block Grant to address fentanyl in educational institutions. Specifically, grant funds may be used to (1) purchase naloxone or other opioid overdose reversal drugs for educational institutions, (2) train school nurses and other personnel on how to administer them, and (3) provide fentanyl awareness classes or materials to students.
